3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.notes:
Whenever you hit a creature with an attack granted by your Flurry of Blows, you can impose one of the following effects:

Addle. The target can't make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

Push. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 15 feet away from you.

Topple. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become Prone.

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.notes:
As a Bonus Action, roll your Martial Arts die. You regain Hit Points equal to the roll + your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1).

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of one), regaining all uses when you finish a Long Rest.

11.name: Fleet Step
11.notes: When you take a Bonus Action other than Step of the Wind, you can also immediately use Step of the Wind.

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.notes:
When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you can expend 4 Focus Points to set up lethal vibrations that last a number of days equal to your Monk level. The vibrations do nothing until you take an action to end them.

Alternatively, when you take the Attack action, you may forgo one attack to end the vibrations. You and the target must be on the same plane of existence.

When you end the vibrations, the target makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 Force damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful one.

Only one creature can be affected by this feature at a time. You may end the vibrations harmlessly at any time (no action required).
